brief:
Israeli spy agency Mossad Chief Roman Gofman traveled to Washington on Friday for discussions with senior Trump administration officials about the war in the region, Middle East Eye reported. Gofman, one of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's closest confidants, met with administration representatives to discuss matters related to Iran.

The meeting took place as regional tensions remain elevated and Israeli-American coordination on security matters continues.
